skill_reference_v2.versions_and_delivery: Same-owner containing references preserve the containing snapshot; cross-owner references use the target selection or its own session pin. An explicit foreign Library is resolved independently and cannot borrow the containing credential/source scope. Missing fixed paths or bytes do not fall back to current. Resource receipts, final request identity and deduplication include exact path and retain optional native File evidence. Original graph closure, delayed commit, provider acceptance, turn completion, current branch, recovery and public projection guards remain intact.
replays: host-refresh/host-prepare: exact physical versus logical denial, cancellation, complete graph and original pins
native-read-session/pi-read-adapter: stable IDs, actual containing file, exact fixed paths and no legacy parameters
session-short-ref/session-short-ref-host: immutable owner/path/native binding, replay and actual manifest checks
fixed-resource-source/scalar-resource-read-host/resource-read-host/notion-entry: exact manifest path, sparse Source bindings and no main activation through resource reads
session-recovery: missing Required detected by parsed exact owner, independent complete closure preserved
real_guard_mutations: All original 33 consumer-state guards and both observations guards retain their original behavioral meaning. The isolation copy now carries the exact selected pure artifact and its verified manifest.

fixed-resource-path-binding and fixed-resource-native-binding are added concrete extension checks with an empty finite properties list and explicit concrete_obligations; baseline, behavioral mutation and byte-identical restoration are required.
skill_reference_v2.proof_limit: No TLA, config, view, bound, case, expected_rules or tool-lock byte is changed. These finite models use abstract identities and pins; they do not prove URI grammar, Library lookup, Source relative mapping, FileID/path bijection, package selection, live authorization or actual provider bytes. Those are concrete regression/integration obligations and the separately owned CLI reference model. Hashes bind reviewed owner/test bytes and do not establish implementation refinement.
skill_reference_v2.source_routing: Only a complete current catalog absence or an explicit descriptor-proven Library mismatch permits trying another configured source. A fixed SKILL_NOT_FOUND, partial catalog or denied response must not be hidden by another source. SNAPSHOT_MISSING retains its dedicated fixed-missing handling and never falls back to current. notion-source-sdk.test.ts exercises the actual source boundary and exact SDK call count.
skill_reference_v2.router_catalog: Direct remote Router catalog entries use the actual pure parser snapshot selection; the required Library query does not imply a fixed snapshot. Exact source namespace, credential scope, logical owner, physical locator and canonical entry checks still precede selection. remote-catalog.test.ts covers a complete current Router with library query and rejection of its fixed snapshot form. This grammar-to-catalog boundary is a concrete regression obligation, not a new finite model rule.
